title: Support for ITE graduates with disabilities in the Work-Study Diploma programme
asked: Ms Yeo Wan Ling asked how SG Enable can support ITE graduates with disabilities to access suitable host companies under the Work-Study Diploma programme.
response: Under the ITE Work-Study Diploma Programme, trainees are hired by participating companies as full-time employees and receive on-the-job training from employers alongside classroom training by ITE. ITE graduates with disabilities can approach SG Enable for employment support from trained job coaches, who help with workplace integration and advise employers on job redesign. SG Enable also connects inclusive employers with ITE and offers disability awareness training, while ITE works with employers on support arrangements such as step-by-step instructions for trainees who need more time to learn.
